question: What is the compound interest (in Rs.) at the rate of 10%, compounded annually, for 3 years on the principal which in 8 years at the rate of 12% per annum gives Rs. 4,800 as simple interest?
solution:
**Formula:**

P = SI×100over R× T

A = P × (1 + Rover 100)T

CI = A - P

where-

P = Principal

SI = Simple Interest

R = Rate

T = Time

CI = Compound Interest

A = Amount

Effective rate = r1 + r2 + r₁ × r₂ over 100

Where “r₁” and “r₂” are rate of interest during successive years.

**Calculation:**

P = 4800×100over 8× 12 = Rs 5000

Effective discount = 10 + 10 + 10 × 10 over 100 = 21%

Final effective discount = 21 + 10 + 21 × 10 over 100 = 33.1%

CI = 5000× 33.1× 1over100 = Rs 1655.

∴** The compound interest on the sum is Rs 1655.**
